card.name: Capital L starting Lymph- and Lact- terms
card.fires_on: The capital letter L that begins a word such as Lymphoma, Lymphoproliferative, Lymphopenia or Lactic, mostly right after a section number like 5.3 in a warnings list. It also fires on L in a drug name or in beta-lactam.
